title: The problems with Helion Energy - a response to Real Engineering
summary: A short, humorous critique of Helion Energy's fusion approach, framed as a response to a Real Engineering video. It covers low reactivity, neutron production, bremsstrahlung losses and diagnostics.
why: HN cites it as a skeptical rebuttal to Helion's promises, usually in threads on fusion power and Helion's Microsoft deal.

quote.text: check out this good summary of all the issues with their approach and promise
